title: Merchant Feed Doctor Input

feed_url.title: Feed URL
feed_url.description: Public URL of a CSV or TSV product feed (Shopify, WooCommerce, or Google). Used if feed_text is empty.

feed_text.title: Feed text
feed_text.description: Raw CSV/TSV content. Takes precedence over feed_url. Ideal for offline / private feeds.

store_url.title: Store URL (Shopify / WooCommerce)
store_url.description: Your shop's base URL, e.g. https://shop.example.com. Shopify and WooCommerce product exports contain no product URLs; with this set, links are built as /products/<handle> (Shopify) or /?p=<id> (WooCommerce).

description: Validate and auto-fix a Google Merchant Center product feed. Paste a CSV/TSV (Shopify export, WooCommerce export or native Google feed) or give a URL.
